verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents a public, no-auth way to check pricing across hundreds of TLDs. Community users say its renewals are cheaper and contrast it with competitors whose renewal prices are obscured or spike after the first year. The evidence does not show a published price list that breaks out registration, renewal, and transfer prices separately per TLD, nor any explicit no-teaser-pricing policy. Missing for 10: documented separate registration/renewal/transfer prices per TLD, an explicit published price-list page, a first-party commitment against first-year teaser pricing.

support.subject: As a founder, the full price list is published — registration, renewal, and transfer priced separately per TLD, with no teaser first-year price hiding a renewal spike

citations.quote: Check domain availability and pricing across hundreds of TLDs (no auth required)
Porkbun is cheaper than Namecheap by a few dollars especially on renewals. Namecheap's renewal price is semi-hidden/obscured
